proposals.title: Proposal 4 – Shareholder Proposal Concerning Shareholder Right to Act by Written Consent
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the board to permit shareholders holding the minimum votes needed to act to take action by written consent.
proposals.evidence: Accordingly, the Board recommends voting against the proposal.

proposals.title: Proposal 5 – Shareholder Proposal Regarding Allocation of Corporate Tax Savings
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report, at reasonable cost, describing how the Company plans to allocate tax savings from the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act.
proposals.evidence: The Board has considered this shareholder proposal carefully and recommends a vote AGAINST it
